headline: Federal Reserve signals easing bias as inflation cools
body: Risk assets including BTC react positively to softer macro expectations.

headline: SEC opens fresh probe into major crypto exchange compliance
body: Traders price in a short-term risk-off move across BTC-linked pairs.

headline: Nvidia buys Hugging Face for $12.9B in push into AI software
body: Nvidia agreed to buy Hugging Face for $12.93 billion, gaining a platform used by more than 18 million developers to share and deploy AI models.

headline: VARA, Securitize sign MoU for tokenization innovation in Dubai
body: VARA and Securitize signed an MoU to foster more tokenization innovation in Dubai and explore how tokenized financial innovation should be regulated in the region.

headline: Recovery specialists crack $1B crypto wallet... but find just $10
body: Crypto recovery specialists reveal how lost wallets, passwords and seed phrases can sometimes be recovered — but that’s of no help if the money was never there in the first place.

headline: Kraken parent Payward partners with SoFi on stablecoin, 24/7 settlement
body: The deal will bring SoFiUSD to Kraken, connect Payward to SoFi’s 24/7 dollar settlement network and give SoFi access to digital asset liquidity through Kraken Prime.

headline: BitMEX co-founder contributed 75% of Reform UK’s donations in Q2 2026
body: The UK political party and its leader, Nigel Farage, have accepted contributions from figures tied to the crypto industry, raising questions about potential influence on policies.

headline: Bybit Pay integrates with Mesh to expand crypto payments
body: The integration lets Bybit users spend digital assets directly from their exchange balances across Mesh-powered platforms.

headline: Bitcoin reclaims $80K as DXY falls amid continuing suspected yen intervention
body: Bitcoin rallied 5% to reclaim $80,000 as the US dollar weakened amid a suspected Bank of Japan currency intervention, though analysts remain split on the impact.

headline: Michigan authorities continue pursuit to block Kalshi as Supreme Court fight looms
body: Kalshi previously said it had been placed in an “impossible position” after federal authorities directed the company to ignore a Michigan restraining order issued in June.

headline: Mantle adds Paxos’ USDG stablecoin, joins Global Dollar Network
body: Mantle has added Paxos-issued USDG as a natively minted stablecoin while joining the network’s reward-sharing structure.

headline: CFTC files to dismiss CME lawsuit over crypto perpetual futures
body: The CFTC’s lawyers called the lawsuit “much ado about nothing,“ claiming that the CME Group lacked standing to file and argued against its claims over crypto perpetual futures.

headline: Tether sued over $42M in frozen coins, 6,600 students get crypto loans: Asia Express
body: Thai businessmen sue Tether over $42M frozen USDT tied to pig butchering scam, Aussie crypto firms face big fines unless they meet licensing deadline.

headline: US, UK launch joint alliance targeting crypto scam centers
body: The agreement includes parallel investigations and information sharing, with US and UK authorities planning a private-sector disruption operation in London in October.

headline: El Salvador’s post-review Bitcoin accumulation used no public funds: IMF
body: The IMF attributed Bitcoin added since June 2025 to private donations, addressing questions raised after El Salvador reported a $100 million acquisition.

headline: Bitcoin ETF inflows hit $731M, highest since January as BTC reclaims $80K
body: US Bitcoin ETFs drew $730.9 million on Thursday as Bitcoin reclaimed $80,000, though CryptoQuant flagged weak fresh demand and a key $83,000 test.

headline: AMC chief criticizes Robinhood’s tokenized stock plan
body: AMC’s CEO criticized Robinhood’s tokenized stock offerings for being unregulated in the US and said he will request an investigation from an external securities counsel.

headline: South Korean regulators introduce tokenized securities roadmap
body: South Korea’s financial regulator introduced a three-phase roadmap for the issuance of tokenized assets, as the country prepares to adopt its first tokenized securities framework in February 2027.

headline: Trezor says data breach affects another 67K US customers
body: Trezor said an additional 67,000 US users were affected by its shipping provider’s data breach, opening the path to potential phishing attacks and social engineering scams.

headline: Kalshi US visits soar 1,500% as regulatory pressure mounts
body: Kalshi’s US web traffic climbed more than 1,500% in less than a year, while trading volume grew even faster and legal scrutiny of its sports contracts intensified.

headline: Token buybacks are booming. But are they good for crypto projects?
body: Crypto projects are spending hundreds of millions buying their own tokens. But are buybacks creating lasting value — or just making tokens look more valuable than they really are?

headline: Revolut, OpenReserve get preliminary US bank approval with crypto plans
body: Revolut and OpenReserve received preliminary OCC approval to form US national banks, with both planning cryptocurrency and stablecoin-related services.

headline: US law enforcement group moves to ‘neutral’ position on CLARITY Act
body: Despite earlier opposition to the CLARITY Act over consumer protection, the National Sheriffs’ Association says it will now “step back and allow the legislative process to proceed.“

headline: QuFi launches post-quantum verification platform with Bitcoin testnet proof
body: QuFi’s new platform uses post-quantum cryptography to verify digital asset transactions without requiring changes to existing blockchain settlement networks.

headline: Crypto Biz: AI took a back seat when Bitcoin started climbing
body: Corporate crypto bets are getting bigger as rising markets reward direct exposure, putting balance-sheet strategies and institutional adoption back in focus.

headline: FinCEN ties $13B in crypto scams to non-US operations
body: The agency reported that “transnational criminal organizations” based in compounds in Southeast Asia were largely behind digital asset scams targeting US residents.

headline: Pineapple Financial puts $1B in mortgage records on Injective
body: The mortgage lender plans to bring more than $10 billion in historical loans onchain, turning thousands of mortgage files into blockchain-based records.

headline: Surprise nonfarm payrolls print sends Bitcoin back below 80K
body: The US economy added far more jobs than expected in August, pressuring Bitcoin lower as traders repriced the odds of a Federal Reserve rate cut this month.

headline: Bitcoin ETF inflows hit $3.8B in strongest three-week stretch of 2026
body: US spot Bitcoin ETFs drew nearly $1 billion in the latest week as Friday inflows stayed positive despite Bitcoin briefly falling below $79,000.

headline: Poland upholds crypto bill veto as Zondacrypto scandal widens
body: Polish lawmakers failed to overturn a presidential veto of crypto legislation as the Zondacrypto investigation expands and its Estonian operator enters bankruptcy.

headline: Here’s what happened in crypto today
body: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

headline: Tether-backed Orionx to shut down after audit flags $7M custody gap
body: Tether-backed Orionx is permanently closing after an audit found more than $7 million in customer assets had moved to wallets outside its custody.
